Before people could understand anything, on the orders of the Circle Inspector, the police force started beating everyone with sticks, and brutally beat the police and the people of the landlord for an hour.

Urlu Kotwar was given a reward of Rs 75 and had the privilege of shaking hands with the Deputy Commissioner, who was no less than a king in the area during this period.
